title: Good and reliable shoe rack
text:
Good and reliable shoe rack. I needed somewhere to put my family's shoes (there are three of us) but also needed somewhere to put our printer and a few other things to make better use of our small space.

Not only do we only use up three shelves and still have one left over, it's sturdy enough to hold the printer, fruit stand, my purse, and since the shelves are mesh, I added some hooks to the side for other things to hang (hats, scarves).

I have bought cheaper ones in the past, the very lightweight ones with tubes and sheets for shelves...it just cannot compare, this one is way better and definitely worth the money.

Great buy, I would recommend.
